# Austria.info

> > Official Austria tourism guide featuring alpine destinations, cultural heritage, winter sports, and UNESCO sites across Vienna, Salzburg, Tyrol, Carinthia, and Burgenland.

Austria.info is the official tourism portal for Austria, providing comprehensive travel information about Austrian cities, alpine regions, ski resorts, cultural attractions, and outdoor activities. The site covers destinations from the Danube Valley wine regions to the highest peaks of the Alps, highlighting UNESCO World Heritage sites, imperial palaces, and traditional Austrian experiences.

## Key Topics

- Alpine tourism & mountain sports
- Winter sports & skiing (Arlberg, Tyrol)
- Vienna cultural attractions & Habsburg heritage
- Salzburg & Salzburgerland
- Carinthia lakes & scenic roads
- Grossglockner High Alpine Road
- UNESCO World Heritage sites (Wachau Valley)
- Austrian wine culture & Heurigen taverns
- Burgenland & Esterházy heritage
- Traditional costumes (Lederhosen & Dirndl)
- Belvedere Palace & imperial architecture
- Innsbruck & Tyrolean Alps
- Family-friendly activities & theme parks
- Wellness & thermal spas

## Major Cities & Cultural Landmarks

- [Belvedere Palace Vienna](https://www.austria.info/ar/locations/belvedere-palace): Belvedere Palace Vienna: baroque architecture, art galleries & gardens
- [Innsbruck: the Alpine city](https://www.austria.info/ar/cities-and-places/innsbruck): Innsbruck highlights: Golden Roof, Ambras Castle, Emperor Maximilian I
- [Austrian Cities in Winter](https://www.austria.info/cs/inspirace/mesta-zima): Austrian cities in winter: Vienna, Salzburg, Innsbruck, Graz attractions

## Alpine Attractions & Scenic Routes

- [Grossglockner High Alpine Road](https://www.austria.info/cs/lokace/grossglocknerska-vysokohorska-silnice): Grossglockner High Alpine Road: Austria's highest mountain scenic route
- [Most Beautiful Round Trips](https://www.austria.info/ar/highlights/most-beautiful-round-trips): Most scenic round trips: Austrian Alps, lakes & mountain roads
- [Scenic Roads in Carinthia](https://www.austria.info/ar/recommendations/carinthia/ar-carinthia-scenic-roads): Scenic roads in Carinthia: Grossglockner, Nockalmstrasse panoramic drives
- [Best Viewing Platforms](https://www.austria.info/ar/highlights/viewing-platforms): Scenic viewing platforms & suspension bridges in Austrian Alps

## Winter Sports & Skiing

- [Largest Ski Areas in Austria](https://www.austria.info/ar/highlights/largest-ski-areas): Largest ski resorts in Austria: Arlberg, Vorarlberg, St. Anton, Lech
- [Salzburgerland in Winter](https://www.austria.info/ar/provinces/salzburgerland-winter): Salzburgerland winter: skiing, alpine activities & romantic getaways
- [Ski & Wellness](https://www.austria.info/ar/highlights/ski-and-wellness): Ski & wellness: Alpine resorts with thermal spas & winter sports

## Lakes & Water Activities

- [Beautiful Carinthia Lakes](https://www.austria.info/ar/recommendations/carinthia/ar-carinthia-lakes): Beautiful Carinthia lakes: Millstatt, Weissensee, Ossiach swimming spots
- [Best Diving Lakes](https://www.austria.info/cs/aktivity/potapeni): Best diving lakes in Austria: crystal-clear waters & underwater world

## Wine Culture & Regional Highlights

- [Wine Cellars & Taverns in Wachau](https://www.austria.info/cs/highlights/vinne-senky-ve-wachau): Wine cellars & taverns in UNESCO Wachau region along Danube River
- [Burgenland Highlights](https://www.austria.info/cs/highlights/zajimava-mista-v-burgenlandu): Burgenland highlights: Eisenstadt, Esterházy Castle, Joseph Haydn heritage

## Austrian Culture & Traditions

- [Traditional Austrian Costumes](https://www.austria.info/ar/inspiration/traditional-costumes): Austrian traditional costumes: Lederhosen & Dirndl cultural heritage guide
- [Famous Austrian Personalities](https://www.austria.info/ar/inspiration/famous-personalities): Famous Austrian personalities: Empress Elisabeth, Habsburg, cultural icons
